E03.quote: comments MUST NOT be included in JSON objects.

E08.context: Well, row and plate; well/plate implement their specs. Empty row/well groups SHOULD NOT exist.

E10.context: Axis name mandatory; type SHOULD and custom string types MAY. Valid custom types do not guarantee a particular reader can render them.

E14.context: Normative prose quotes the value; JSON examples use numeric 3. Plate metadata takes precedence when top-level represents plate; image collections cannot be mixed with plates.

E15.quote: If the "series" attribute does not exist and no "plate" is present:
E15.context: Then consecutively numbered groups starting 0; series optional list of string paths ordered as XML Images if XML supplied; XML SHOULD exist and uses MetadataOnly if present.

E16.quote: SHOULD make users aware of the presence of more than one image
E16.context: MAY show all images or offer choice; MAY use series and ignore extraneous groups. Awareness SHOULD does not require showing all images.

E17.quote: The transformations in the list are applied sequentially and in order.
E17.context: General transform types include identity default, translation, scale; vectors may be inline or stored via path.

E18.context: 2-5 dimensional multiscale; optional one time and one channel/null/custom. Axis order corresponds array order and time, channel/custom, space. Anisotropic zyx is SHOULD.

E19.quote: relative to the current zarr group.

E20.quote: They MUST contain exactly one scale transformation
E20.context: Only scale and translation; scale physical size/duration or relative factor when physical scale unavailable/applicable. Optional exactly-one translation follows scale; vectors match axes.

E21.quote: If scaling information is not available or applicable for one of the axes
E21.context: Relative-to-first-level factor required in this case, 1 when no downsampling. Relative values alone do not prove physical calibration.

E22.context: Optional multiscale-level transform follows dataset transforms, subject to same type/order rules; name,type,metadata SHOULD fields.

E23.quote: using the first multiscale as a fallback:
E23.context: Named-multiscale selection/pseudocode; informative example, not a universal pyramid-level policy.

E24.context: Example contains channel label/active/coefficient/family/inverted and rdefs defaultT/defaultZ/model; their guaranteed presence not stated by normative requirements.

P02.context: Background reads/cancellation, understandable failures, real tools interoperability, additional capability choices explicit review, calibration/alignment/responsiveness acceptance. No concrete fixtures.

material_claims.claim: Case,date,source URI/hash/896 lines,brief/plan bytes and source scope are stated.
material_claims.rationale: Admitted identity values match; TASK and seed pins are not phase1 authority.

material_claims.claim: Complete fresh reads,seed verification,probe errors,all citations checked,no native/shell/code/GET/tests and immutable verification/acquisition records claimed.
material_claims.rationale: All seed/history/verification/native/tool/acquisition artifacts remain locked; exact read/probe/check operations unknown. No negative operational inference. Current conclusions themselves are assessed below.

material_claims.claim: Whole brief in two groups,status vocabulary and exact source/brief/plan locators.
material_claims.rationale: All topical sections exist. Lowercase RFC keywords retain force only in normative text; examples do not become binding from imperative style.

material_claims.claim: S003 fully determines on-disk contract,while reader implementations/Zarr internals/real compatibility remain unknown.
material_claims.rationale: OME metadata rules are detailed,but referenced Zarrv3 mechanics and binary path encoding are not fully captured. Fully determines is too broad; admitted-source limits are correctly visible elsewhere.

material_claims.claim: Thin plan core compatible; metadata discovery,axes,transforms,labels/defaults add required details; real-tool and performance evidence unresolved.
material_claims.rationale: Compatible plan intent and omissions supported. Every proposed extension is not automatically a normative mandate; disputed extensions below are separated.

material_claims.claim: Zarrv3 permits codecs/grids/keys/dtypes/transformers unless disallowed; backend limits get graceful refusal; no disallowance anywhere.
material_claims.rationale: Permission and explicit limits sound. No particular codec restriction exists,but blanket no-disallowance overlooks image rank/order and label integer constraints.

material_claims.claim: Storage location agnostic; local-only,read-only/session settings and explicit non-goals narrow product scope.
material_claims.rationale: Correct format-versus-product boundary; no remote capability mandated.

material_claims.claim: Metadata attributes.ome,version string hierarchy-consistent; only0.5 in contract,other versions best-effort or rejected with caveat.
material_claims.rationale: Explicit version/layout admission and truthful unsupported policy; malformed and unsupported distinctions retained. Best-effort must not claim conformance.

material_claims.claim: Lowercase RFC2119 terms carry force; explicit non-normative/examples/notes excepted; transitional reading may required/recommended and writing usually optional.
material_claims.rationale: Correct general convention; lowercase exception does not override example status or turn arbitrary imperative into MUST.

material_claims.claim: JSON comments forbidden.
material_claims.rationale: Direct format rule,not an executed parser check.

material_claims.claim: Exact camelCase exceptions required on read; private viewer-store camelCase is product convention,not source recommendation.
material_claims.rationale: Correct literal-key lookup and current C3 correction.

material_claims.claim: Images are groups,levels arrays with their own zarr.json; Zarrv3 parsing is a dependency.
material_claims.rationale: Correct representation and decoding relationship; backend breadth may be bounded truthfully.

material_claims.claim: Distinguish plain,HCS,b2raw; plate first then collection then multiscales and report ambiguity.
material_claims.rationale: Source-defined families and precedence justify refinement; shape sniffing algorithm is product design,not sole universal source algorithm.

material_claims.claim: Keep source bytes unchanged and session-local settings; no obligatory writeback in S003.
material_claims.rationale: Correct already-covered disposition.

material_claims.claim: Named-multiscale choose-by-name/first fallback imperative is binding or uniquely required despite example placement.
material_claims.rationale: It is informative pseudocode/example guidance. Lowercase keyword caveat cannot create obligation from use it or override explicit example exception. Adoption is a permissible product choice.

material_claims.claim: HCS enumeration uses plate wells/consistent0-based paths and well fields/acquisition IDs; all physical rows/columns listed,empty groups discouraged.
material_claims.rationale: Detailed hierarchy/discovery rules correct and useful; flat UI with qualified identities remains valid product choice.

material_claims.claim: Plan flat list cannot express plate/well/acquisition identity.
material_claims.rationale: Detailed identity unspecified,not proven shallow/flat discovery. A flat list with metadata qualifiers can be sufficient,as report acknowledges choice.

material_claims.claim: b2raw value3,optional series XML-order paths,numbered fallback only absent series/plate,MetadataOnly XML SHOULD,plate precedence.
material_claims.rationale: Correct conditions mostly preserved; quotation3 does not prove string-only type. XML/series conditionality must remain attached.

material_claims.claim: Multi-image awareness SHOULD adopted as required for plan acceptance; reader must never silently open only image0.
material_claims.rationale: Source SHOULD and MAY show-all/choice accurately quoted. Product may adopt stronger acceptance; it must remain a declared product bar rather than unconditional format minimum. L80 labels the promotion,which receives policy credit.

material_claims.claim: Label contents MUST NOT be listed as primary images and must only be overlays.
material_claims.rationale: Source says labels group contains images and label images implement multiscales. It does not prohibit standalone/primary listing. Separate overlay presentation is a product policy,not a format MUST.

material_claims.claim: Row/column/field identifiers unique,alphanumeric,case-sensitive; preserve exact case and avoid filesystem collision.
material_claims.rationale: Correct identifiers and meaningful local-reader implications.

material_claims.claim: Row has no metadata section,so directory scanning alone is always non-conforming discovery.
material_claims.rationale: Plate/well declared paths are authoritative and row has no dedicated OME schema. No source prohibits directory enumeration for candidate discovery followed by metadata validation; internal algorithm mandate is overstated.

material_claims.claim: Fields carry acquisition when multiple performed; IDs nonnegative unique and match plate; names/maxfieldcount recommended,timestamps optional.
material_claims.rationale: Accurate structural conditions; identity keyed by well/acquisition/path is sound proposal.

material_claims.claim: field_count/name/maxfieldcount and acquisition names SHOULD be shown as display hints.
material_claims.rationale: Source recommends field presence/types,not mandatory reader display. Displaying supplied hints is useful product choice; counts are maxima rather than image enumeration keys.

material_claims.claim: Require acquisition only if plate.acquisitions length>1,honor IDs otherwise and flag dangling references.
material_claims.rationale: Dangling checks valid; source trigger is multiple acquisitions performed,not explicitly array length. The chosen heuristic is stated but cannot redefine normative validity for incomplete/ambiguous metadata.

material_claims.claim: Required multiscales axes/datasets/group-relative paths/ordered levels,rank/order/name equality and dimension_names; mismatch refusal/skip-with-message.
material_claims.rationale: Full declared-level identity; no silent remapping and unavailable level/backend feedback are explicit.

material_claims.claim: Names/type/downscaling metadata SHOULD be surfaced in level selection.
material_claims.rationale: Source SHOULD is metadata inclusion in file. UI exposure is a useful inferred policy,not source-required reader presentation.

material_claims.claim: Highest-resolution gloss is defined but its scalar metric not; total voxel count sanity-check without reordering.
material_claims.rationale: Correct metadata authority and current C1 gloss correction. Total voxel count is not a source-defined resolution metric and may misflag anisotropic/nonuniform extents; preserve order and label heuristic rather than normative violation.

material_claims.claim: Keep pan/zoom,level-per-view and background/cancellation; add metadata traversal,validation,transforms,multiscale policy and per-level unsupported feedback.
material_claims.rationale: Core and most extensions sound; first-fallback requirement remains informative/policy. Level-specific geometry and missing/unavailable decoding handled explicitly.

material_claims.claim: Chunked multi-GB-capable data indirectly creates performance obligation; no source threading model,product responsiveness/cancel outcome required.
material_claims.rationale: Product outcome is required by brief/plan. Capture does not state multi-GB sizes or prove architecture necessity; data-scale reasoning is an engineering inference,not measured implementation evidence.

material_claims.claim: Adopt item-scoped malformed/unsupported taxonomy and alternative selection,no crashes/silent skips.
material_claims.rationale: Named source violations and backend limitations mostly correctly distinct. Window out-of-range/reversed limits elsewhere are not established source violations; metadata/palette mandates must keep true force.

material_claims.claim: Axes2-5,2-3space,optional time/channel-or-null/custom,type-order,array-order,unique names; zyx recommendation.
material_claims.rationale: Complete rank/order composition and arbitrary naming properly stated.

material_claims.claim: Controls follow axes; absent time/channel hides controls;2space has no z-slider; plane always two innermost spatial axes.
material_claims.rationale: Presence policy valid. Source only recommends zyx in stated anisotropic case; fixed innermost-plane interpretation is a product orientation choice,not universal spatial identity. Absent versus present singleton control behavior unspecified.

material_claims.claim: Missing/null/custom type/unit tolerated,unknown units caveated,positional inference only labeled best-effort; custom types outside capability can be unsupported.
material_claims.rationale: Valid feature need not be rendered universally. R8 truthfully allows limits. Positional role guessing cannot support a claim of validated calibrated semantics; label uncertainty instead of inventing known t/c/z identity.

material_claims.claim: Array-zarr.json dimension_names normative rule beats history phrase in axes; follow array location.
material_claims.rationale: Correct exact normative placement. Whether external validators enforce both remains unknown.

material_claims.claim: Omero optional; supplied channels color/window mandatory file contents; no universal reader window/color rendering MUST.
material_claims.rationale: Correct current C2 distinction; transitional read policy motivates product defaults without mandatory every-field renderer.

material_claims.claim: Best-effort active/label/rdefs/window/color initialization; absence fallback,overlap-degrade list-size mismatch.
material_claims.rationale: Example-only defaults and source-limited size expectation correctly retained; precise contrast interpretation is explicitly product policy.

material_claims.claim: Out-of-dtype window values or start>end are malformed-input violations,though source lacks out-of-range rules.
material_claims.rationale: Six-hex color/required fields are structural obligations. S003 does not prohibit those numerical windows or define their rendering; inability to use them is a product capability/validation policy,not established format invalidity.

material_claims.claim: General sequential identity/translation/scale with path variant; image chain only scale/translation,exactly one scale,conditional physical/relative values,after-scale translation,matching vector lengths.
material_claims.rationale: Correct source rules and explicit availability/applicability conditions.

material_claims.claim: Multiscales transforms follow dataset transforms and both must be composed for calibrated viewing.
material_claims.rationale: Correct prose order. Identity/nonidentity scope applies; source does not require optional global list exist.

material_claims.claim: Coordinate=global(scale∘translate)∘perLevel(scale∘translate).
material_claims.rationale: Under standard composition notation each scale∘translate applies translation before scale. Correct chain within each list is translation∘scale. Outer group-after-dataset is right; current prose and equation conflict materially.

material_claims.claim: Source example voxel/time values0.5/1/2µm and0.1ms,channel×1; current-level hover transform and details suggested.
material_claims.rationale: Values match informative example. Channel×1 there does not prove all channel axes dimensionless. Detailed panel fields are reasonable product implications,not all format mandates.

material_claims.claim: Details should include per-axis extent/name/type/unit/scale/group/composed coordinates,level path and pyramid info.
material_claims.rationale: Useful source-to-plan extension with honest none/unknown units; precise panel layout remains product choice.

material_claims.claim: Missing unit forces scale to relative factor; channel axes never have meaningful physical scale and only index displayed.
material_claims.rationale: Unit is recommended and scale physical availability is a separate condition. Missing unit does not prove relative-factor basis; source supplies no universal ban on physical/custom channel calibration. Report uncertainty should not be replaced by invented semantic classification.

material_claims.claim: Translation origin undefined,assume image-group frame and disclose.
material_claims.rationale: Offset/source coordinate-space relation given; no absolute external origin fully specified. Stated frame assumption is acceptable product limitation if association remains validated.

material_claims.claim: Binary-path vectors underdefined,unsupported unless backend resolves with transform/level message.
material_claims.rationale: Valid format versus reader capability distinction,not malformed merely for using path.

material_claims.claim: Missing scale/wrong vectors/other types/translation-before-scale malformed,image-level explanatory refusal.
material_claims.rationale: Accurate source violations; no test execution claimed.

material_claims.claim: Labels discovered from declared paths,arbitrary names,metadata-free intermediate groups; full listing SHOULD,scan unlisted policy.
material_claims.rationale: Correct hierarchy and scope; reader may choose explicit scan/ignore policy without confusing labels group with image.

material_claims.claim: Label multiscales and integer8/16/32/64 dtypes required,equal level count; violations per-overlay errors.
material_claims.rationale: Correct format constraints. Exact wide-integer decoding still unaddressed.

material_claims.claim: Same-index label level,broadcast singleton dimensions,compare composed geometry,warn divergence; own transforms used.
material_claims.rationale: Appropriate registration proposal but equal count alone does not supply source association. Warning alone must not imply unsupported geometry is aligned; source.image identity needs validation before overlay.

material_claims.claim: Labels must not interpolate as continuous intensities; nearest-neighbor policy follows integer categorical semantics.
material_claims.rationale: Sound inference/product resampling choice preserving categorical IDs. Does not yet address wide-int precision/range or sparse-key lookup tests.

material_claims.claim: image-label SHOULD,colors/version inside it: colors entries integer keys,optional rgba4uint8,properties/source optional;version string MUST be present.
material_claims.rationale: Types and optional metadata correct. Source SHOULD contain both colors and version; MUST refers to their value types if present,not unconditional version-key presence.

material_claims.claim: Given image-label,version key mandatory.
material_claims.rationale: Converts SHOULD key inclusion into MUST existence; valid omission should not automatically be malformed.

material_claims.claim: Readers SHOULD honor specified colors/alpha;extra keys and per-value properties allowed;fallback palette and legend choice.
material_claims.rationale: Appropriate recommendation and explicit product fallback; property lookup must preserve exact label-value identity.

material_claims.claim: source.image is followed only to annotate provenance,never to relocate overlay.
material_claims.rationale: The reference identifies original image; ignoring its association can attach labels to wrong image even with matching extents. Declared identity must be resolved/validated or explicitly unsupported before overlay. Provenance-only treatment fails associated-overlay scope.

material_claims.claim: Accept any string schema versions,show them,never gate;label own transforms verified,parent precedence uncertain.

material_claims.claim: SHOULD reasoned exceptions and MAY metadata/capabilities enumerated; private-store naming identified as policy.

material_claims.claim: Listing UI,selection/cache/defaults/palette/scanning/version/path/uncalibrated/errors/performance budgets require review.

material_claims.rationale: All plan sentences accounted for. Keep decisions generally sound; required label exclusion/first-fallback and source-provenance-only policy are unsupported. Raising acceptance is a product proposal,not preexisting source threshold.

material_claims.claim: Backend/path/custom limits are valid-undisplayable; source violations malformed;nonlocal/edit/export/other versions outside product;message+continue.

facets.title: Versioned metadata admission
facets.rationale: Version/layout explicitly gate admission:v3,attributes.ome,consistent0.5,other versions out-of-contract or visible best-effort/refusal. No implicit legacy reinterpretation.

facets.title: Axis-to-array identity
facets.rationale: Rank/order/unique arbitrary names and dimension_names validated;absent axes handled. Untyped positional role inference only labeled best-effort,but singleton distinction missing.
missing: Explicit absent versus present length-one image-axis controls/slicing behavior.
Do not promote positional role inference or innermost-plane preference into validated semantic identity.

facets.title: Declared pyramid selection
facets.rationale: Arbitrary group-relative declared paths/order,each level own geometry,no numeric-name rule,and item-scoped missing/unavailable/malformed level handling provided. Total-voxel-count sanity check is only an unsupported scalar heuristic,not authority or reorder policy.

facets.title: Composed coordinate calibration
facets.rationale: Prose correctly states level then group and scale then translation,but displayed equation reverses each inner scale/translation chain. Missing unit wrongly proves relative scale;channel physical calibration categorically excluded.
missing: An unambiguous correct composition formula and numeric offset-bearing oracle.
Distinguish unknown unit/scale semantics from automatic relative-factor classification;no invented channel-scale restriction.

facets.title: Associated label discovery and registration
facets.rationale: Declared paths,intermediate groups,count/dtype,own geometry and singleton handling covered. Explicit policy uses source.image only as provenance instead of resolving original-image association before overlay.
missing: Resolve/validate explicit or default relative source.image from label-image location and refuse/redirect unsupported association.
Geometry warnings must not falsely imply intended source identity or alignment.

facets.title: Categorical label identity

missing: Exact sparse/wide integer identity through decode and lookup,including values beyond binary64 range,or explicit supported range/refusal.
Order-independent sparse-key and wide-ID fixture checks.
